description:
Logs a request for a spec that doesn't exist yet and notifies maintainers.
Call this when a user asks for a provider or capability that has no spec in the registry (check list_providers first),
or needs a capability in a country where no listed provider offers it (search_specs with country first).
This helps maintainers prioritize which specs and providers to add next.

Args:
  - capability (string): Capability name e.g. "create_payment", or what is needed e.g. "ussd"
  - provider (string?): Provider slug e.g. "wave" — omit when no provider is named
  - country_code (string?): ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code e.g. "SN" — required when provider is omitted
  - follow_up ("none" | "github_issue", default "none"): "none" records the request only;
    "github_issue" also returns issue_url, a pre-filled GitHub issue the user can review and submit

Returns: { logged: true, count, issue_url? } if the request was recorded — count is the all-time
number of times this provider + capability (or, without a provider, capability + country) was
requested, including this one (a repeated request counts again). count is absent if it could not be determined: do not
guess a number. issue_url only with follow_up "github_issue": give it to the user, who submits it.
{ logged: false, reason: "spec already exists" }: the spec is in the registry — use the existing spec
(get_spec) instead.
isError if the request could not be stored: tell the user it was NOT recorded.

capability.description: Capability name e.g. "create_payment", or what is needed e.g. "ussd"

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code e.g. "SN" — required without provider

follow_up.description: "github_issue" also returns issue_url, a pre-filled GitHub issue the user can submit
